#### **How does the relative abundance of an indicator organism change over time?** 

Because the exact number of organisms cannot be determined from this eDNA sampling data, relative abundance is calculated to give an idea of how common an organism's DNA is within a sample in comparison to other organisms. 

The graph shows the relative abundance of the selected organism each season. **For example, in spring 2025, the selected organism made up X% of all samples that season.**

*Select a taxa and season(s) at the top of the page. Hover over points for details.*
